Titel: Interim Head of Compliance & AML (m/f/d)
Unternehmen: Parvion Payments GmbH
Ort: Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany (Hybrid)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187320451/
Abgerufen am: 22.09.2026 08:10

About the job
Parvion Payments is a licensed e-money institution supervised by BaFin, serving around 4,000 merchants across the DACH region. Following a regulatory audit earlier this year, we are strengthening our second line of defence. We are looking for an interim Head of Compliance to lead the function until our permanent hire joins in Q2 2027.

Your responsibilities
Act as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (Geldwäschebeauftragter) including the notification to BaFin
Remediate the audit findings, including the risk analysis under Section 5 GwG and the transaction monitoring scenarios
Oversee KYC and KYB onboarding and the sanctions screening process
Report monthly to the management board and quarterly to the supervisory board
Lead a team of 6 compliance analysts, 2 of them based in Lisbon
Prepare the company for the EU AML package (AMLR, AMLA) and support the DORA implementation

Requirements
7+ years in compliance or AML at a bank, payment institution or e-money institution
Previous experience as MLRO or deputy MLRO
Solid knowledge of GwG, ZAG, MaRisk and the BaFin interpretation and application notes (AuA)
Hands-on experience with remediation projects after a regulatory audit
Fluent English; German is a strong plus for correspondence with BaFin

Nice to have
Experience with rule-based and machine learning transaction monitoring tools
CAMS or a comparable certification

What we offer
Interim contract for 9 months with an option to extend
Day rate: 1,200 to 1,400 EUR
Start: as soon as possible, by 15.10.2026 at the latest
Hybrid: 3 days on site in Frankfurt, 2 days remote

Seniority level: Director
Employment type: Contract
